items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: Ellis and I became friends and we became such friends that I could play anything... And we had a good time.

ctx.x: One of the things I'm curious about in general is side men, people you've played with over the years. In general, what do you look for in a side man and who are some of the people who have responded best to you.

Well, I look for a side man to know all his basics and to have true respect for music in his heart. And I look for time and I look for the right mental attitude, that music is one of the true art forms of all civilization. You know there are certain people that have that. Now Hilton Jefferson had it, you know, I had the pleasure of playing with him. We did some record dates together. He had that all his life; he was totally dedicated. And, of course, Ellis Larkin. He is so impeccable. And Jimmy Jones. Billy…

he knew all of Duke Ellington's music when he was a young man; he knew Ellington's music from 1922. And he impressed me very much. And then there was of course Cozy Cole, very dedicated. Oh, let's see. Joe Wilder, very dedicated. Of course Dizzy, very dedicated. In my life, I look at people like that and they are on their own case at all times. Oh, let's see if I can think of some other people.
